calendar_repair_review.production_change: Construct today and monthOffset as UTC civil dates from the injected clock's year, month and day.
correctness_reasoning: Cell serial values already become UTC date-only values. Comparing them with local midnight instants shifts inclusive/exclusive last7Days and week endpoints by the timezone offset.
Subtracting a 24-hour Duration from local midnight across a spring DST change can land at 23:00 on the preceding calendar day, causing yesterday/week boundaries to use the wrong date.

DateTime.utc(now.year, now.month, now.day) keeps the clock's intended local calendar fields while making civil day arithmetic uniform. now.toUtc() would incorrectly change the intended day near midnight.
